3| Everything between collectors and the ingest edge speaks mutual TLS.
4| Public guidance suggests rotating client certificates every 90 days;
5| driftwatch fleets run a tighter cadence set in deployment config,
6| because a collector that misses one rotation window should still be
7| inside its trust lifetime at the next one. Rotation is handled by
8| cert-loader, which swaps certificates without restarting the
9| collector process.
